json.justification: The electric meter (photo 11) sits very close to a corner, and the adjoining wall shown in photos 12-14 has windows almost immediately after the corner, leaving little to no clear wall run for wiring or an install spot. There's also a paved patio/walkway and deck area right next to the meter whose drivable status is unclear, plus AC units and a gas meter elsewhere on the property that could conflict with clearance requirements.
